status: Preregistered source proposal before any candidate runtime; root review required; no acceptance result implied
scope: Five fixed steps at 1e-4 s from .600 to .6005; pinned flat N8/10cm/922576 seed; functional validation only
exact_identities: C29 whole/body/include hashes and pinned mesh/U/p/rotorParameters/physical bytes
Parsed initialized U,p,phi numerical values agree exactly before the timestep comparison; shared phi fallback if necessary
Fresh temporary source and every allocated implicit/boundary coefficient are exactly zero before C29; all implicit/boundary coefficients remain exactly zero afterward
Exactly one C29 call/update per consecutive time index; exactly five TILT/source observations and ten pressure correctors
identity_meaning: Floating-point source accounting, not CFD uncertainty: positive temporary force matches craftForce, its work is -Pair; applied matrix delta force is -craftForce and work is +Pair. Cached-volume check repeats existing weights, not an independent geometry experiment.
field_metric_definition: At every matching saved step, compare all internal values and boundary values separately. RMS error divided by max(reference RMS, floor); maximum magnitude error divided by max(reference maximum magnitude, floor). U uses vector magnitude. Fixed-total-pressure p is compared absolutely, without subtracting its mean.

solver_and_flow_checks.actual_selected_solvers: UFinal, p then pFinal at each step; tolerance1e-7, correct relTol; no solver failures/max-iteration warnings

decision_rule: All required checks must pass; failures/near misses remain failures for review. No averaging away a failing sample. If final parity fails, compare saved viscous/Euler/momentum/pressure diagnostics in a separately reviewed diagnostic run. Do not adjust thresholds after seeing results without a new explicitly exploratory protocol.
limits: These are practical short-test acceptance proposals, not proof of full cross-branch equivalence, long-time stationarity, ranking accuracy, hardware prediction or performance. Actual GPU launch/memory evidence and exact build/input identities are separate gates. Root approval is separate from permission to perform an unvalidated experiment.
